correctness.rationale: The image of a graph endomorphism is a contiguous interval, and idempotency fixes that interval; left/right exterior walks are independent and give the exact convolution. Verified sine eigenvalues and principal endpoint coefficient b_r~4/r including the negative parity eigenvalue, controlled spectral remainder summability, uniform saddle r~c n^(1/3), second derivative -(3 log2/c)n^-1/3 and Gaussian n^1/6 window with exponential tails. Independent direct enumeration of all endomorphisms for n=2..9 agrees with walk convolution, including n=9 histogram (8,44,38,22,10,5,2,1); this alone is not an infinite proof.

The submitted principal Gaussian n^1/6 rank limit and explicit variance are not stated there, in the separate Margolis–Rhodes partial strict graph-semigroup idempotent theorem, or in the Dimitrova et al semigroup-generator-rank paper. residual_risks: A generic transfer-matrix saddle-point CLT could subsume the asymptotic without naming paths; not established by the inspected prior papers. The finite convolution is unequivocally prior work and is not original.

final_claim: The exact image-rank enumeration N_n,r=sum_{ell=0}^{n-r}w_r(ell)w_r(n-r-ell) for strict idempotent endomorphisms of loopless P_n, together with log I_n=n log2-(3/2)c log2 n^(1/3)+o(n^(1/3)) and (R_n-cn^(1/3))/n^(1/6)=>N(0,c/(3log2)), c=(pi^2/log2)^(1/3).
limitations: Only undirected labeled loopless strict (not weak/partial) path endomorphisms; image rank, not generator rank; finite brute force does not prove Gaussian limit.
